items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: and I think Carl Nilsson was even there.

ctx.x: Politiken, yeah. And I saw the reviews of that. And of course there you appeared on the same bill with the Danish Symphony Orchestra, and I think Carl Nilsson was even there.
Yes. I had a couple of writeups also from the symphony orchestra leader in Berlin, too, and the one in Copenhagen. But I lost them. I would have liked to have them, but I lost them.
